paper_title: Vestibular Evoked Myogenic Potential (VEMP) Dynamics: A Physics-Informed Neural Network Approach
hypotheses: H1: PINN trained on VEMP stimulus-response data can learn vestibular mechanical-electrical transduction physics
H2: PINN-predicted parameters can distinguish normal vs SCI vs vestibular neuritis vs Meniere's
H3: PINN can infer unmeasured otolithic states from sEMG alone
contributions: First PINN/NeuralODE model of VEMP dynamics
Learned physiological parameters as biomarkers for vestibular dysfunction
Non-invasive otolithic function assessment via sEMG-only measurement
